text:
rachel: Heads-up: Company all-hands this Wednesday 9:30am PT. Please add Qs here. Zoom in calendar. :loudspeaker:

rachel: Tentative agenda:
```
- 9:30 - 9:35: Quick metrics + shoutouts (Rachel)
- 9:35 - 9:50: Product GA + Dedicated v2 timing (Tessa)
- 9:50 - 10:00: Security & privacy policy updates (Karen)
- 10:00 - 10:10: Infra incident recap + reliability roadmap (Anil)
- 10:10 - 10:20: Hiring update + new IC compensation framework (Carlos)
- 10:20 - 10:30: Live Q&A + 2-min team demos
```

rachel: If you want a 2-min demo slot, reply with the team name and a one-line blurb. If you have a private/sensitive question, DM me or Karen and we can raise it anonymously.

tessa: Product will announce GA schedule for Dedicated v2 and the early-adopter program. Well briefly show perf numbers and compatibility notes.

karen: Security note: small language change to data retention policy (customers over 90-day retention now require explicit opt-in). Will share a doc in the calendar invite. No action required for most teams, but please review if you handle customer data.

anil: Ill cover the outage from Feb 28 in 2 slides: sequence of events, immediate mitigations, and the 30/60/90 day reliability plan. Short TL;DR here: cascading autoscale edge-case + mem leak on retry logic. Fixes in progress.

carlos: Hiring: were opening 10 IC roles across infra/product/ML. Also updating IC compensation bands next quarter; HR drop-in next Tue.

infra-bot: deploy: Scheduled kernel pin rollout Wed 01:00 PT to stabilise affected images.

person1: demo-request: "ML infra Two-min demo: prompt-lifecycle dashboard"

person2: question: "Any change to SLA during Dedicated v2 GA?"

tessa: @person2 Great Q Well cover SLA implications in the GA slide; short answer: no SLA reduction for existing customers, new tiers added.

rachel: Also note: marketing will share a customer story slide. If you contributed to the case study, tag Jordan in PMs so we can include quotes.

-- (WEDNESDAY AFTER MEETING) --

recorder-bot: Recording + transcript posted: https://drive.redwood.ai/ah/1793456789-recording.mp4 and https://drive.redwood.ai/ah/1793456789-transcript.txt

anil: Outage recap summary: root cause = autoscaler race causing duplicate recovery paths and eventual mem pressure; blast radius = hosted region-west; impact = ~5m elevated p95 + intermittent request errors for some tenants. Actions: revert risky autoscale change, add canary rollout for autoscaler, memory leak fix PR #4521, and better telemetry for retry/backoff metrics. Owners: @anil (autoscaler canary), @ml-ops (PR #4521).

tessa: Dedicated v2 GA notes: rollout week starts next Monday; early-adopter signups open (forms link below). Migration guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/product/dedicated-v2-migration. If you own customer migrations, please review and flag gaps by Fri EOD.

karen: Policy doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/security/data-retention-updates. Legal + Compliance reviewed. If you need help communicating to customers, reach out.

carlos: Hiring + comp next steps: HR office hours Tue 3pm PT; link in calendar. Well also post the IC band FAQ in the handbook.

rachel: Top action items: 1) @tessa publish GA timeline and customer comms draft by Thu; 2) @anil schedule autoscaler canary and post update by Mon; 3) @karen coordinate customer-facing email template by Fri; 4) @carlos publish comp FAQ by next Wed.

person3: thanks for the recap, recording is helpful :clap:

rachel: Thanks all. If anything needs exec attention, flag with the :exclamation: emoji and well escalate.

recorder-bot: Thread pinned to #all-hands and recording posted.
